change: Serialize forgetAll and backup on the same per-Store queue, flush prior writes, and persist/mirror the cleared archive before releasing the lock.
safetyFact: Forget waits for an in-flight backup; a backup queued after forget cannot observe the pre-forget archive. UI mutations stay locked until the final queued operation finishes.
proofLevel: Real running Store in isolated Chrome; authentication held and cancelled at the external boundary.
cleared: Both operation orderings preserve age confirmation and erase facts durably across reload.
The existing owner-checked mirror is used for the cleared archive; production identity checks are unchanged.
limitations: Remote Apple authentication and Supabase persistence were not exercised by this race probe. Existing mirror boundary tests cover owner-scoped deletion.
Native storage, device frame rate, and Apple sign-in remain unverified.
